source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Check this trigger during the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase). Roll a D6 if the Wolf Guard Battle Leader is destroyed and the Wolf Guard Battle Leader’s unit still awaits its fight activation. A 2+ keeps the destroyed model in play to fight on the same activation as the Wolf Guard Battle Leader’s unit. If they have yet to fight when the phase closes, fight then. Remove the destroyed model once it has fought.

reminder.unresolved: An independent review against the official text found this reading wrong or incomplete; it stays withheld until a fix is reviewed again.
